question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_season_races AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.year, r.round, dr.driver_id, dr.constructor_id
    FROM results dr
    JOIN races r ON dr.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_first_last AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id,
           MIN(round) as first_round,
           MAX(round) as last_round,
           COUNT(DISTINCT round) as num_distinct_rounds
    FROM driver_season_races
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round) >= 2
),
first_constructor AS (
    SELECT dsr.year, dsr.driver_id, dsr.constructor_id as first_constructor
    FROM driver_season_races dsr
    INNER JOIN driver_first_last dfl 
        ON dsr.year = dfl.year AND dsr.driver_id = dfl.driver_id AND dsr.round = dfl.first_round
),
last_constructor AS (
    SELECT dsr.year, dsr.driver_id, dsr.constructor_id as last_constructor
    FROM driver_season_races dsr
    INNER JOIN driver_first_last dfl 
        ON dsr.year = dfl.year AND dsr.driver_id = dfl.driver_id AND dsr.round = dfl.last_round
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fc.driver_id)
FROM first_constructor fc
JOIN last_constructor lc ON fc.year = lc.year AND fc.driver_id = lc.driver_id
WHERE fc.first_constructor = lc.last_constructor
